title: RBC 2018 30 ONLINE v02
description: RBC Race for the Kids began in 2008 with the first event in New York City. Created as a platform to encourage employee engagement through corporate social responsibility, the money raised for each RBC Race for the Kids event is contributed to charities all over the world that support children and youth.  Sign-up and visit us online: https://rbcr4tkottawa.ca/
